observation: Localized card page identifies Indonesian Snorlax 091/123 with Pelahap and Tumbang, illustrator Toshinao Aoki, in the Ledakan Peniada booster.
Inspected publisher render reads MA4 I, 091/123, regulation J, rarity C, Pelahap and Tumbang. The render establishes the printed fields. The render does not establish physical foil treatment.
The publisher's Indonesian deck list labels the exact card Snorlax MA4 091/123.
The publisher lists 3 April 2026 as the sales start of the Indonesian Ledakan Peniada booster.
The Enhanced 2-Pack Blister with Snorlax, Morpeko and Applin began distribution in mid-July 2021. Snorlax from Sword & Shield is listed as Cosmos Holofoil.
An opening of the named sealed product identifies its Snorlax as Sword & Shield 140/202 with cosmic holo treatment.

The owner identifies their inbox photograph as the English Sword & Shield Snorlax 140/202 Cosmos Holo from this blister. The inspected preview shows English card text and round reflections in the artwork. The private upload remains in the inbox.
The owner identifies the photographed Indonesian MA4 I 091/123 as Non-Holo.
The owner reports that French Ronflex 140/202 may have a Cosmos Holo printing. Physical finish, distribution and release date are still unverified.
